## Summary

-

## Commit Convention

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`)
- [ ] Scope added by app/package when helpful (example: `feat(web): ...`)

## Validation Checklist (Required Before Merge)

- [ ] Lint passed
- [ ] Type checks passed
- [ ] Relevant tests passed
- [ ] Next/Express build(s) run locally (if applicable)

## UI Changes

- [ ] UI screenshots attached (required for UI changes)

## Ops / API Notes

- [ ] Env updates documented
- [ ] DB updates documented
- [ ] Swagger/API spec updates documented
